segments.source: Transitions the video to a different experience.
Call this method to transition to a different experience such as [`AVExperienceController.Experience.expanded`](avexperiencecontroller/experience-swift.enum/expanded.md).
segments.ko: Call this method to transition to a different experience such as [`AVExperienceController.Experience.expanded`](avexperiencecontroller/experience-swift.enum/expanded.md).

segments.source: When you initiate a transition, the system calls the experience controller’s delegate methods so your app can respond to experience changes.
segments.ko: 전환을 시작하면 시스템이 경험 컨트롤러의 delegate 메서드를 호출하므로 앱에서 경험 변경에 대응할 수 있습니다. 전환의 성공 여부는 이 메서드가 반환하는 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult.md)를 평가하여 판단합니다.

segments.source: You determine the success of a transition by evaluating the [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult.md) this method returns.
segments.ko: 이 메서드가 반환하는 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult.md)를 평가하여 전환의 성공 여부를 판단합니다.

segments.source: A transition result of [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult.completed`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult/completed.md) indicates a successful transition, in which case the system updates the [`experience`](avexperiencecontroller/experience-swift.property.md) property to the new experience.
segments.ko: 전환 결과가 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult.completed`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult/completed.md)인 경우 전환이 성공한 것입니다. 이때 시스템은 [`experience`](avexperiencecontroller/experience-swift.property.md) 속성을 새 경험으로 업데이트합니다.

segments.source: A transition result of [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult.reversed(reason:)`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult/reversed(reason:).md) indicates a failed transition.
segments.ko: 전환 결과가 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.TransitionResult.reversed(reason:)`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/transitionresult/reversed(reason:).md)인 경우 전환이 실패한 것입니다.

segments.source: Evaluate the the result’s [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.ReversedReason`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/reversedreason.md) to determine why the transition failed.
segments.ko: 전환 실패 원인을 확인하려면 결과의 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.ReversedReason`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/reversedreason.md)를 평가합니다.

segments.source: A failure that occurs before the transition begins results in the system not invoking any delegate callback methods.
segments.ko: 전환이 시작되기 전에 실패가 발생하면 시스템이 delegate 콜백 메서드를 호출하지 않습니다.

segments.source: If the failure happens after the callback to [`experienceController(_:prepareForTransitionUsing:)`](avexperiencecontroller/delegate-swift.protocol/experiencecontroller(_:preparefortransitionusing:).md) occurs, the transition context changes to [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.Status.finished(result:)`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/status-swift.enum/finished(result:).md).
segments.ko: [`experienceController(_:prepareForTransitionUsing:)`](avexperiencecontroller/delegate-swift.protocol/experiencecontroller(_:preparefortransitionusing:).md) 콜백이 실행된 후에 실패가 발생하면 전환 컨텍스트가 [`AVExperienceController.TransitionContext.Status.finished(result:)`](avexperiencecontroller/transitioncontext/status-swift.enum/finished(result:).md)로 변경됩니다.
